purpose: Held-out boundary questions over a second manuscript (A Princess of Mars, Project Gutenberg #62, imported by tools/manuscript_import.py into 8 parts). Written on 2026-11-11 from a reading of the imported parts, before any pipeline run on this novel, and never to be tuned against. The novel was chosen to break the assumptions the first fixture satisfied: first-person narration (the coreference layer rewrites third-person pronouns only), invented proper names, dialogue and facts spread across all eight parts rather than one. Same contract as questions.json: passages must bind to exactly one manuscript unit at run time; the novel's answer vocabulary is not the pass oracle.

cases.question: In my manuscript, how far does John Carter clear in his first deliberate sak leap before the Tharkian warriors?

designated.passage: cleared a good hundred and fifty feet

cases.expected: A hundred and fifty feet, bound to the part01 source. The sentence's subject is the first-person narrator, not the name in the question; abstains rather than guessing if the source is absent.

cases.question: How many souls do the hordes of Thark number, and how many Warhoons filled the amphitheater for the great games?
cases.expected: Thirty thousand for Thark and twenty thousand for Warhoon, attributed without swapping; the two values live in different parts, each bound to its own source block.

cases.question: Who is Kantos Kan when the narrator first meets him in the Warhoon dungeon?

designated.passage: a padwar (lieutenant) in the navy of Helium

cases.expected: A padwar, or lieutenant, in the navy of Helium, bound to the part06 source; no invented rank or ship.

cases.question: How many days after his arrival on Barsoom does the narrator enter the city of Thark?

designated.passage: Just thirty days after my advent upon Barsoom

cases.expected: Thirty days, bound to the part05 source. First-person subject; the question says 'the narrator' and 'arrival' where the text says 'my advent'.

history.content: Note for later: Dejah Thoris is the daughter of Tardos Mors.

cases.question: Earlier I told you Dejah Thoris is the daughter of Tardos Mors; I was wrong, the text says otherwise. Whose daughter does she say she is?

designated.passage: daughter of Mors Kajak of Helium

cases.expected: Follows the author's correction toward the source (Mors Kajak) and says the earlier note is superseded; does not keep Tardos Mors as her father. Tardos Mors is her grandfather, which may be stated only if a source carries it.

history.content: Draft note (older): In the first draft the atmosphere plant had ten radium pumps.

cases.question: My two drafts disagree about how many radium pumps the atmosphere factory has. Which figure does the current manuscript give, and what did the other draft say?

designated.passage: a battery of twenty radium pumps

cases.expected: Reports both figures with their provenance (current manuscript twenty; older draft note ten) and does not merge them or pick silently.

cases.question: What is the name of John Carter's horse in the Arizona chapters of my manuscript?
cases.expected: States that the supplied sources do not give the name; must not assert it is never given anywhere, and must not guess a name.

cases.question: Draft two sentences, in Burroughs's register, of Woola waiting outside the doors of the atmosphere factory. Mark it as new writing.

designated.passage: Woola and I stepped forth into the darkness

cases.expected: Produces the requested draft, marked as proposed writing rather than canon; no refusal and no reclassification of the request as a factual one.
